title: Parity baseline requests
description: The `requests` field of parity/baselines/<id>/legacy.json (scripts/parity-record.js --har), from Parity.requests(har, {baseUrl}). Endpoints and payload shapes only: no value, query string or identifier.

path.description: URL path, no query; numeric and uuid segments are :id

shape.description: null: no body. string: a Parity.shape leaf, 'bool' or 'null'. array: [] or one element, the shape of the first record. object: the body's keys with shapes.
